definitions.short: Edrei , the name of two places in Palestine
definitions.full: H154. Edrei אֶדְרֶ֫עִי proper name, of a location a chief city of Bashan אֶדְרֶ֖עִי Josh 19:37 ; אֶדְרֶ֑עִי Num 21:33 = Deut 3:1 , 10 ; בְּאֶדְרֶ֑עִי בְּעַשְׁתָּרֹת 1:4 ; וּבְאֶדְרֶ֑עִי בְּעַשְׁתָּרֹת Josh 12:4 ; 13:12 ; compare 13:31 ; — on identity of all these compare Di Deut 3:10 ; modern Der`ât , 7 2-Janhours west-northwest of Bosra; Euseb. Ἀδραά (Lag Onom. 213, 86 2nd ed. 235 ) compare Di Num 21:33 Wetzst Hauran 47, 77, 123 Bd Pal 201 .

occurrences.englishText: They turned and went up by the way of Bashan. Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.
after he had struck Sihon the king of the Amorites who lived in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan who lived in Ashtaroth, at Edrei.
Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan. Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.
We took all the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, to Salecah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
and the border of Og king of Bashan, of the remnant of the Rephaim, who lived at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,
all the kingdom of Og in Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei (who was left of the remnant of the Rephaim); for Moses attacked these, and drove them out.

Half Gilead, Ashtaroth, and Edrei, the cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were for the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even for the half of the children of Machir according to their families.
